nodes.name: pagination.rs
nodes.summary: Cursor-based, filterable pagination over events stored in the EventStore, avoiding full-list transfer to the frontend; supports forward/backward cursors and combinable source/variant/text filters.

nodes.name: paginate_events
nodes.summary: Returns a cursor-paginated, filtered slice of events from the store along with next/prev cursors and the total match count.

nodes.name: count_matching_events
nodes.summary: Counts how many stored events match a given filter set without materializing them.

nodes.name: get_distinct_functions
nodes.summary: Computes the distinct set of function names present in the event store along with usage counts, for filter UI population.

nodes.name: matches_filters
nodes.summary: Evaluates whether a single event matches the combined set of active EventFilters (source, variant, function, path, text, time range).

nodes.name: payload_compaction.rs
nodes.summary: Compacts oversized event payload fields (message/tool bodies exceeding a size threshold) into a truncated preview plus a lazily-loadable body reference, keeping snapshot/IPC payloads small while preserving reload-on-demand access.

nodes.name: compact_event_for_snapshot
nodes.summary: Compacts a single event's oversized payload fields for inclusion in a lightweight snapshot, replacing full bodies with size-bounded previews.

nodes.name: load_event_payload_body
nodes.summary: Loads back the full-size body of a previously compacted payload field on demand.

nodes.name: compact_display_text
nodes.summary: Truncates an event's display text to the preview size threshold if it exceeds the compaction limit.

nodes.name: compact_json_string_field
nodes.summary: Compacts an embedded JSON-string field's value if it exceeds the size threshold, preserving JSON validity.

nodes.name: compact_string_value
nodes.summary: Truncates a raw string value to the preview byte budget, cutting on a valid character boundary.

nodes.name: compact_extracted
nodes.summary: Walks an ExtractedData variant's fields, compacting any oversized text/content fields in place for snapshot storage.

nodes.name: compact_optional_string
nodes.summary: Compacts an Option<String> field, replacing it with a preview if it exceeds the threshold.

nodes.name: payload_string
nodes.summary: Reads a payload's original field value as a string for size measurement and compaction.

nodes.name: camel_to_snake
nodes.summary: Converts a camelCase field-path segment to snake_case for payload field lookups.

nodes.name: search.rs
nodes.summary: In-memory full-text search across session chat events (plain, case-sensitive, regex, whole-word modes), replacing a TypeScript linear-scan search hook to avoid IPC-serializing the full event list.

nodes.name: extract_strings_from_value
nodes.summary: Recursively collects all string leaves from a JSON value into a flat searchable text buffer.

nodes.name: build_searchable_text
nodes.summary: Builds the combined searchable text blob for a single event from its display text and extracted-data fields.

nodes.name: floor_char
nodes.summary: Rounds a byte offset down to the nearest valid UTF-8 character boundary.

nodes.name: ceil_char
nodes.summary: Rounds a byte offset up to the nearest valid UTF-8 character boundary.

nodes.name: create_snippet
nodes.summary: Builds a bounded-length text snippet around a match position, with ellipsis truncation at character boundaries.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Matches a Matcher::Plain or Matcher::Regex variant against a byte offset in the searchable text, returning the start/end/score of a match.

nodes.name: build_matcher
nodes.summary: Constructs a Matcher (plain substring or compiled regex) from the search query and case/regex/whole-word options.

nodes.name: search_chat_events
nodes.summary: Runs the configured search over a session's chat-visible events, returning ranked, snippeted results up to a max-results cap.

nodes.name: session_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Pure policy layer tracking the active session, a pin set protecting long-running agent sessions from eviction, and an LRU order enforcing a max cached-session limit, decoupled from the per-session EventStore instances themselves.

nodes.name: set_active
nodes.summary: Marks a session as the active target for commands that omit an explicit session id.

nodes.name: register
nodes.summary: Registers a newly-seen session with the manager, initializing its LRU/touch state.

nodes.name: touch_lru
nodes.summary: Moves a session to the most-recently-used end of the LRU order.

nodes.name: enforce_limits
nodes.summary: Evicts least-recently-used, unpinned sessions once the known-session count exceeds the configured cache limit.

nodes.name: SessionStoreManager
nodes.summary: Manages the set of known/pinned/active sessions and an LRU eviction order across per-session EventStore instances, enforcing a maximum cache size.

nodes.name: session_providers.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the SessionProvider trait and its Cursor-IDE and managed-CLI implementations, abstracting per-source differences in session-id matching, cache-save behavior, and history loading for imported/external sessions.

nodes.name: load_history_events
nodes.summary: Loads prior history events for a session from whichever external CLI adapter matches its imported session id.

nodes.name: subagent_prompt
nodes.summary: Resolves a subagent's delegation prompt via the matching external CLI adapter.

nodes.name: imported_parent_session_ids
nodes.summary: Collects the set of imported parent session ids across all registered external CLI adapters.

nodes.name: SessionProvider
nodes.summary: Trait describing source-specific behavior (session-id matching, cache-save skipping, history loading, subagent prompt resolution) implemented per session origin (native, Cursor IDE, external CLI).

nodes.name: CursorIdeProvider
nodes.summary: Provider implementation matching Cursor-IDE-imported session ids and skipping event-cache persistence for them.

nodes.name: ManagedCliProvider
nodes.summary: Provider implementation for internally-managed CLI agent sessions (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), which participate in normal event-cache persistence.

nodes.name: statistics.rs
nodes.summary: Aggregates statistics across session records (counts by status/type, file-change totals, per-repo and per-model activity, daily activity buckets, most-impactful sessions) without loading full event data.

nodes.name: compute_session_statistics
nodes.summary: Computes the full SessionStatistics aggregate (status/type breakdowns, per-repo/model activity, daily timeline, top impactful sessions) from a list of session records.

nodes.name: empty_statistics
nodes.summary: Returns a zeroed/empty SessionStatistics value for when there are no sessions to aggregate.

nodes.name: SessionStatistics
nodes.summary: Aggregate statistics result: totals by status/type, file-change sums, per-repo and per-model activity breakdowns, daily activity timeline, and most-impactful sessions.

nodes.name: event_ops.rs
nodes.summary: Single-event and batch mutation operations on EventStore: get/update/upsert, streaming finalization, transcript deduplication, stream-placeholder replacement, shell output/process stamping, and bulk removal/clear.

nodes.name: update_by_id
nodes.summary: Updates an event in place by id, refreshing store indexes.

nodes.name: upsert
nodes.summary: Inserts a new event or updates an existing one by id, maintaining id/call-id indexes and streaming/version bookkeeping.

nodes.name: complete_last_running
nodes.summary: Marks the most recent running tool/task event as completed.

nodes.name: finalize_streaming_events
nodes.summary: Finalizes any events still marked as streaming when a session's live stream ends, converting them to their terminal display state.

nodes.name: patch_by_ids
nodes.summary: Applies a set of field patches to multiple events identified by id.

nodes.name: truncate_before_id
nodes.summary: Removes all events preceding a given event id, used to trim history before a resumption point.

nodes.name: remove_by_id_prefix
nodes.summary: Removes all events whose id starts with a given prefix.

nodes.name: remove_by_ids
nodes.summary: Removes a set of events identified by exact id.

nodes.name: remove_synthetic_user_inputs
nodes.summary: Removes synthetic/placeholder user-input events matching given criteria from the store.

nodes.name: replace_and_remove
nodes.summary: Atomically replaces a set of events with new ones while removing others, reconciling indexes in a single pass.

nodes.name: update_last_shell_output
nodes.summary: Appends incremental output to the most recent matching shell command event during live streaming.

nodes.name: update_last_shell_process
nodes.summary: Updates process metadata (pid, status, exit code) on the most recent matching shell command event.

nodes.name: update_last_matching_args
nodes.summary: Updates the args payload of the most recent event matching given function-name criteria.

nodes.name: clear
nodes.summary: Removes all events and resets store indexes.

nodes.name: remove_matching_synthetic_transcript_placeholders
nodes.summary: Removes synthetic stream-transcript placeholder events matching given predicate criteria.

nodes.name: matching_synthetic_transcript_placeholder_ids
nodes.summary: Collects the ids of synthetic stream-transcript placeholder events matching given criteria.

nodes.name: remove_events_by_ids
nodes.summary: Removes a batch of events identified by an explicit id list.

nodes.name: replace_duplicate_stream_transcript_in_current_turn
nodes.summary: Replaces a duplicate/superseded streaming transcript event within the current turn with its authoritative counterpart.

nodes.name: replace_matching_stream_placeholder
nodes.summary: Replaces a matching streaming placeholder event with finalized content once the authoritative event arrives.

nodes.name: would_downgrade_terminal_tool_call
nodes.summary: Checks whether applying an incoming update would downgrade an already-terminal tool-call event's status.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Pure, store-state-free helper functions for EventStore internals: synthetic/placeholder detection, transcript text/key extraction, and turn-id bookkeeping, kept separate for easy unit testing.

nodes.name: is_synthetic_transcript_placeholder
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event is a synthetic (not-yet-authoritative) streaming transcript placeholder.

nodes.name: transcript_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the display transcript text used for deduplication/matching from a session event.

nodes.name: transcript_message_key
nodes.summary: Builds a dedup key from a transcript message's source and text for matching duplicate events.

nodes.name: normalized_event_text
nodes.summary: Returns a whitespace-normalized version of an event's display text for comparison.

nodes.name: is_completed_authoritative_stream_transcript
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event is a completed, authoritative (non-placeholder) streaming transcript message.

nodes.name: is_authoritative_transcript_message
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event's source/variant marks it as an authoritative transcript message.

nodes.name: reconcile_loaded_synthetic_transcript_placeholders
nodes.summary: Reconciles freshly loaded events against previously known synthetic transcript placeholders, dropping stale placeholders superseded by authoritative content.

nodes.name: is_turn_placeholder
nodes.summary: Determines whether an event is a turn-body placeholder used by round-window pagination.

nodes.name: placeholder_turn_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the turn id a placeholder event stands in for.

nodes.name: placeholder_next_turn_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the id of the turn following a placeholder, for ordering.

nodes.name: loaded_turn_ids_from_events
nodes.summary: Collects the set of turn ids that have full event bodies currently loaded.

nodes.name: timeline_source_order
nodes.summary: Returns a stable ordering key for an event's source, used to order concurrent timeline entries deterministically.

nodes.name: stream_placeholder_prefix_for_authoritative
nodes.summary: Derives the placeholder id prefix that should be reconciled once an authoritative streaming message with a given key arrives.

nodes.name: hydration.rs
nodes.summary: Bulk event loading and merge operations for EventStore: full/round-window hydration, incremental appends, and the two-phase merge path used when paginating a round window of turns.

nodes.name: set_round_window
nodes.summary: Replaces the store's events with a round-window slice and marks the store as round-window hydrated.

nodes.name: set_with_hydration
nodes.summary: Replaces the store's events with a caller-specified hydration mode (full, round-window, or live-partial).

nodes.name: append
nodes.summary: Appends new events to the end of the store, updating indexes and version/change tracking.

nodes.name: merge_events
nodes.summary: Merges a batch of events into the store using the default (non-round-window) merge path.

nodes.name: merge_round_window_events
nodes.summary: Merges a batch of events into the store using the round-window-aware merge path.

nodes.name: merge_events_with_hydration
nodes.summary: Merges a batch of newly-loaded events into the existing store contents according to the current hydration mode, reconciling placeholders and ordering.

nodes.name: remove_turn_placeholders_for_turns
nodes.summary: Removes turn-preview placeholder events for a given set of turn ids once their full bodies are loaded.

nodes.name: sort_round_window_events_by_timeline
nodes.summary: Sorts a round-window's events into correct timeline order after a partial merge.
